description: One test of the smoke and CO detectors in one camp building. A propane heater in a cabin with an untested CO detector is how somebody dies in their sleep, which is why this is a record with photographs and not a tick on a clipboard.

fields.description: The building. A passing test moves this unit's `smoke_detector_last_test` and `co_detector_last_test` forward, which is what takes `housing_detector_test_stale` off the calendar.
fields.label: Housing Unit

fields.description: The day somebody pressed the button. Not the day it was typed up.
fields.label: Test Date

fields.description: COMPUTED, never chosen. Both detectors passing gives Recorded. A Fail, a detector that is Not Present, a replacement needed, or anything written in the findings routes it to Corrective Action Required — which raises a Critical alert that persists until the fault is closed or a later clean test of the same building supersedes it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Hold this record in Draft. A Draft writes nothing to the unit and dismisses no alert.
fields.label: Keep as Draft

fields.description: The Employee id of whoever tested it. Data and not a Link because Frappe HR is not a dependency of this app.
fields.label: Tester

fields.description: The Farm Task whose completion produced this record, blank where somebody recorded the test directly.
fields.label: Source Task

fields.description: Pass, Fail or Not Present. NOT PRESENT IS NOT A PASS AND IS NOT AN OMISSION — it is the finding that there is no detector in a building somebody sleeps in, and it is why the option exists rather than leaving the field blank.
fields.label: Smoke Detector

fields.description: Pass, Fail or Not Present. A cabin heated with propane and no working CO detector is the single most dangerous state this app records.
fields.label: CO Detector

fields.description: A unit needs new hardware. Set automatically when either detector failed or is not there, and settable by hand for one that passed but is out of its service life — most domestic detectors are rated for ten years.
fields.label: Replacement Needed

fields.description: The Farm Task raised to go and fit the new detector. Written by create_detector_test, which raises one rather than leaving 'replacement needed' as a checkbox nobody is dispatched against.
fields.label: Replacement Task

fields.description: Anything else seen while testing. Blank on a clean test.
fields.label: Findings

fields.description: The day the detector was actually replaced or repaired. Setting it takes the Critical alert off the calendar; a later clean test of the same building does the same without anybody remembering this field.
fields.label: Corrective Action Closed

fields.description: Photographs of the test. A photograph of the detector with its test light on is worth more than the row it sits beside.
fields.label: Photos

fields.description: The phone's request ID. A resend of the same walk answers with this record.
fields.label: Request ID

fields.description: The phone's clock when it was done (site time).
fields.label: Done on the phone at

name: Detector Test
